servers.name: vault-fs
servers._purpose: Structured filesystem operations (read, write, list, search) scoped to the Wisdom Nexus vault. Adds tool-calling-friendly file primitives over the dispatcher's existing file_read/file_write surface.

servers.name: playwright
servers._purpose: Browser automation — navigate, click, fill, screenshot, console. Complements the existing internal Playwright path used by web_fetch's channel=local tier.

servers.name: github
servers._purpose: GitHub repo / issue / PR operations. Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the orchestrator's environment (inherited from the shell that started Ora). Fails-soft if the token is absent — the github server reports startup failure and the dispatcher routes the other two servers normally.

notes: Each server entry: {name, transport (stdio|http), command (for stdio) or url (for http), args (optional), env (optional)}. Servers are initialized at orchestrator startup. Servers that fail to start are logged but do not block the orchestrator. The _purpose / _env_required fields are documentation only — the MCP client ignores underscore-prefixed keys. Path values in command/args/env/url may use ${ORA_HOME} / ${ORA_VAULT} / ${ORA_CONVERSATIONS} / ${ORA_SCRATCH} placeholders — resolved at launch time from the same-named env var when set, else from orchestrator/runtime_paths.py defaults — so the checked-in config carries no machine- or platform-specific absolute paths.
_execution_review: Per-server mutability/sensitivity/egress axes are read by tool_events.mcp_axes for the gate. A server without declared axes fails closed (gated). All MCP calls record enforcement_model=boundary_only regardless — the server subprocess is opaque to per-call interception.
